content_units: February 11 Meeting Agenda at a Glance
Meeting date:   2026-02-11
Time zone:   Eastern Time (  UTC-05:00  )
Total duration:     90 minutes
Participants:   Product Manager, Engineer 1, Engineer 2, Designer, Sales Lead
Key constraint built in:   one engineer exits after   60 minutes  , so technical/risk discussion is front-loaded.
Minute-by-Minute Meeting Schedule
Time (ET)   Duration   Segment   Lead   Outcome
9:00 AM–9:10 AM   10 min   Team updates   Product Manager   Quick status round from all attendees
9:10 AM–9:25 AM   15 min   Customer complaints from enterprise accounts   Sales Lead   Shared understanding of top issues and urgency
9:25 AM–9:45 AM   20 min   Release risks   Engineer 1 + Engineer 2   Confirm major technical and delivery risks before one engineer leaves
9:45 AM–10:00 AM   15 min   Q2 feature priorities   Product Manager + Designer   Narrow priority set using customer and risk context
10:00 AM   —   Engineer departure   —   One engineer leaves after 60-minute mark
10:00 AM–10:15 AM   15 min   Ownership assignments   Product Manager   Assign owners for priority areas, complaints, and risk follow-ups
10:15 AM–10:30 AM   15 min   Decisions and next steps   Product Manager   Final decisions, owners, deadlines, and recap
Facilitated Agenda Flow
9:00 AM-9:10 AM — Opening updates
- 2 minutes: Product Manager opens meeting, confirms goals and timing
- 5 minutes: Fast round-robin updates from PM, engineers, designer, sales lead
- 3 minutes: Confirm any urgent changes to agenda
9:10 AM-9:25 AM — Enterprise customer complaints
- 5 minutes: Sales Lead summarizes top complaints from enterprise accounts
- 5 minutes: Team clarifies frequency, revenue impact, and affected workflows
- 5 minutes: Identify which complaints must influence Q2 priorities immediately
9:25 AM-9:45 AM — Release risk review
- 5 minutes: Engineer 1 reviews current technical blockers
- 5 minutes: Engineer 2 reviews dependencies, capacity, and timing risks
- 5 minutes: Designer flags UX or handoff risks affecting release quality
- 5 minutes: Agree on top risks that need mitigation before next milestone
9:45 AM-10:00 AM — Q2 feature priorities
- 5 minutes: Product Manager presents proposed Q2 priority list
- 5 minutes: Group discusses trade-offs using complaint and risk inputs
- 5 minutes: Align on which features are highest priority, deferred, or need more validation
10:00 AM-10:15 AM — Ownership assignments
- 5 minutes: Assign owner for each top complaint follow-up
- 5 minutes: Assign owner for each major release-risk mitigation item
- 5 minutes: Confirm feature area ownership across PM, engineering, design, and sales support
10:15 AM-10:30 AM — Decisions and next steps
- 5 minutes: Read back final decisions
- 5 minutes: Confirm deadlines, dependencies, and communication plan
- 5 minutes: Document action items and close
Ready-to-Use Meeting Agenda
Title:   Q2 Priorities, Enterprise Feedback, and Release Readiness Review
Date:   February 11, 2026
Time:   9:00 AM-10:30 AM ET (UTC-05:00)
1. Updates and opening round — 10 min
2. Enterprise customer complaints review — 15 min
3. Release risks and mitigation discussion — 20 min
4. Q2 feature priorities — 15 min
5. Ownership assignments — 15 min
6. Decisions and next steps — 15 min
Quick Actions
Copy Agenda
Share ET Time
Planning Notes
Built into this schedule:
- All engineer-heavy discussion happens in the first   60 minutes
- The final   15 minutes   are reserved only for decisions and next steps
- Updates are contained to the first   10 minutes   as requested
- Ownership is set before closing so action items are ready immediately after the meeting
